memory-master 2.0.0

- Major update with revised, streamlined skill description and updated feature highlights.

- Security and privacy sections clarified, emphasizing 100% local operation and user control.

- Adds automatic web search and learning: when local knowledge is insufficient, the system will now auto-search the web to expand its knowledge base.
- Updated documentation to describe auto-learning instead of requiring explicit user triggers for web search.

memory-master v1.3.1

- No functional/logic changes—documentation consistency and assurance of local-only operation.

memory-master v1.3.0

- Clarified that "network learning" means web search only; explicitly states it does NOT upload anything.
- Updated description and documentation to reflect web search as a local, explicit, user-triggered feature (not automatic and not data upload).
- Improved wording for security, privacy, and user control.
- No functional or protocol changes — documentation and terminology update only.

memory-master 1.2.9

- Clarified network learning as a strictly separate, 100% user-triggered feature (not automatic)
- Updated description and key features for clearer privacy, security, and user control messaging
- Removed "optimization" from tags (now: [memory, recall, indexing, context])
- Improved phrasing and emphasis: all knowledge/memory stays local unless user explicitly issues a search command

- Improved description clarity to emphasize local storage, user control, and optional network learning.
- Updated feature list: network learning is only triggered by explicit user authorization; all files are fully visible, editable, and deletable.
- Minor adjustments to tags and documentation wording for better accuracy.
- No changes to functionality or logic; documentation update only.

Memory Master v1.2.7 — Focus on privacy and clarity

- Updated the description to highlight “local-only storage” and clarify network learning requires explicit user consent
- Reworked Security & Privacy section: now clearly states that all memory is stored locally, is transparent, and controlled by the user
- Removed references implying non-local or background network activity without consent
- Description and documentation improved for user understanding
- No code or functional changes, documentation update only

**Improved installation and initialization flow, plus template updates**

- Installation instructions now clarify how to safely replace old memory rules in MEMORY.md before adding new ones.
- Updated SKILL.md to provide precise, step-by-step manual and auto-init setup guidance, improving the onboarding process.
- Refined template files (`daily-index.md`, `knowledge-index.md`) for clarity and correct initialization.
- General documentation cleanup and expanded instructions for index and knowledge base usage.

memory-master 1.2.5

- Clarified that memory writing must be auto-triggered immediately after conclusions, decisions, actions, or important events—no user reminder required.
- Updated write flow instructions for stronger emphasis on automatic detection and writing of important information.
- Minor documentation improvements for clarity and strictness of memory-trigger logic.
- No changes to the technical implementation; this release focuses on behavior and protocol enforcement.

**Memory Master v1.2.4 Changelog**

- Added optional network learning: now the agent can search the web for new knowledge when explicitly authorized by the user.
- Enhanced user privacy and safety: all memory and knowledge data are stored locally, with clear warnings not to save secrets or sensitive data.
- Increased transparency and control: all writes are visible and editable by the user at any time; network activity only occurs after user consent.
- Improved documentation to clarify security boundaries, optional network actions, and user triggers for learning and recall.
- Updated description and feature list for clarity on new capabilities and privacy guarantees.

- Added recommended auto-initialization option via `clawdhub init memory-master`
- Updated installation instructions for easier setup and automation
- Clarified manual vs automatic initialization steps
- No functional/logic changes to recall or memory processes
- Documentation improvements for setup and onboarding

- Added an installation section to SKILL.md, detailing how to use the new templates/memory-master-rules.md file.
- Introduced instructions to copy rules from the new template into your MEMORY.md.
- No logic or rules changed; this update is documentation and setup improvement only.
- No impact on existing usage—safe upgrade for all users.

- Minor documentation update: The "Knowledge Base System" section has been rewritten for greater clarity and simplicity.
- The knowledge index format is now described as a minimal keyword list, instead of key-value mappings.
- The knowledge base recall protocol is clarified—only search/read if no relevant info is present in current context.
- Problem solving and example flows for the knowledge base have been updated to match the new, simplified approach.
- No functional or technical changes; this release is documentation-only.

**Memory Master v1.2.0 — Major Upgrade with Proactive Recall & Knowledge Base**

- Switched to structured "因-改-待" (Cause-Change-Todo) memory entries for clarity and universal usability.
- Added heuristic recall: system now proactively restores context instead of waiting for user triggers.
- Introduced a persistent knowledge base (`memory/knowledge/` with index) for solution learning and re-use.
- Revised index formats for both daily and knowledge memories, enabling fast, topic-based lookups.
- Updated best practices: write immediately after decision points, always sync indices, and learn proactively when info is missing.
- Authorship updated to 李哲龙.

Memory Master 1.1.0 changelog:

- Added new templates: daily-index.md and knowledge-index.md for expanded template support.
- Removed legacy templates: memory-index-en.md and memory-index.md.
- Updated documentation to reflect template changes.

- Improved documentation in README.md for clarity.
- Enhanced memory index templates in both English and default versions.
- No functional changes; update is documentation and template only.

Memory Master 1.0.0 — initial release

- Introduces tag-based precision memory storage and recall
- Supports bidirectional index synchronization for always-current memory tracking
- Enables instant, zero-token-cost recall by reading only relevant tagged sections
- Provides markdown-based templates and detailed usage instructions for easy adoption
- No external APIs or embeddings required; works natively with OpenClaw setup
